name: aai-acpmcp
description: Discover Best Buy products, check availability by SKU and ZIP code, and get related accessory suggestions for browser-based shopping.

interface.longDescription: Discover Best Buy products and get related accessory suggestions in ChatGPT. Check product SKUs with a US ZIP code for delivery and nearby store pickup availability, and view product details when available. Use returned Best Buy cart links, when available, to continue shopping in a browser or with a computer-use agent (CUA).
capabilities: Check SKU and ZIP code availability
defaultPrompt: Show me details for a Best Buy product.

positive.description: Check delivery and pickup availability for one product.
positive.prompt: Check Best Buy SKU 5463303, quantity 1, at US ZIP 55102 for delivery and nearby pickup. Show product details and price when available. Do not start checkout.
positive.expected_behavior: Check postal_code 55102 and one item with sku_id 5463303 and quantity 1. Report delivery and pickup separately using the returned values, with available product details and price. Treat unknown availability as unknown. Do not create a checkout or place an order.

positive.description: Check a gaming desktop at the supplied ZIP code.
positive.prompt: Can Best Buy deliver SKU 6625786, quantity 1, to ZIP 55102, or is nearby store pickup available? Show the current product details when available.
positive.expected_behavior: Check sku_id 6625786 with quantity 1 and postal_code 55102. Return the current delivery and pickup results and available product details without inventing missing prices or promising stock.

positive.description: Check multiple products in one availability request.
positive.prompt: Check Best Buy SKUs 5463303 and 6672948, quantity 1 each, for delivery and nearby pickup at ZIP 55102. List the results separately for each SKU.
positive.expected_behavior: Check both SKU IDs with quantity 1 at postal_code 55102. Present per-item delivery and pickup availability and available metadata, keeping each result associated with the correct SKU. Do not infer that either item is available from the other item's result.

positive.description: Provide a returned Best Buy link for continued browser shopping.
positive.prompt: Check Best Buy SKU 5463303, quantity 1, at ZIP 55102 and give me the returned Best Buy cart link, if available, so I can continue shopping in my browser or with a computer-use agent. Do not purchase anything.
positive.expected_behavior: Check the specified SKU and ZIP code. If the result includes cuaUrl, present that returned link without constructing or altering it. If no link is returned, explain that a cart link is unavailable. Do not claim to have opened a browser, created a cart, completed checkout, or placed an order.

positive.description: Get related accessory suggestions for a product.
positive.prompt: Suggest related Best Buy accessories for SKU 6672948. Show the returned accessory SKUs and product details when available. Do not add anything to a cart.
positive.expected_behavior: Request recommendations for sku_id 6672948. Show up to three returned accessory SKU IDs and available accessory details. If no accessories are returned, say no suggestions were found. Do not invent suggestions, guarantee compatibility, claim availability was checked, or add products to a cart.

negative.description: Order-history and refund requests are outside product discovery and accessory suggestions; do not invoke the plugin.
negative.prompt: Find my previous Best Buy orders and refund my last purchase.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not invoke discovery or recommendation tools. Explain that order history and refunds are not supported by this plugin and direct the shopper to Best Buy support without requesting credentials.

negative.description: A request to change an existing delivery is not a product availability lookup; do not invoke the plugin.
negative.prompt: Change the shipping address on my existing Best Buy order to a different address.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not invoke discovery or recommendation tools or collect an address. Explain that the plugin cannot modify existing orders and direct the shopper to Best Buy's order-management or support channels.

negative.description: General technical advice without a shopping or product lookup intent should not trigger the plugin.
negative.prompt: Explain the difference between OLED and LCD displays. I am not shopping and do not want product suggestions.
negative.expected_behavior: Answer the general question without invoking Best Buy tools, requesting a ZIP code, or inserting product suggestions.

review.commerce_description: Supports Best Buy product discovery, SKU and ZIP code availability checks, and related accessory suggestions. Returned Best Buy cart links, when available, support continued shopping in a browser or with a computer-use agent (CUA). The app does not manage checkout, process payments, or place orders.

publication.release_notes: Initial production release with product discovery, SKU and ZIP code availability checks, related accessory suggestions, and browser or CUA shopping links, plus official Best Buy icons and customer support, privacy policy, and terms of service links.
